messages:
olivia-partners: Quick sync — putting a draft here for the sandbox seed + demo data we'll push to partners' marketplaces (Snowflake / Databricks) and the vector DB bundles. Need legal + engineering + docs alignment before we hand to partner. emoji :seedling:

sam-marketing: High level: we want 3 things from the demo bundle — (1) reproducible sample dataset, (2) quickstart notebook, (3) clear licensing + privacy note. Prefer synthetic where possible. :white_check_mark:

devin-ps: We generated a 10k-row synthetic corpus with topic labels. Includes a mapping CSV for embeddings and original doc IDs. Using the same pipeline as internal demos. I can share the S3 link to the seed.

ines-legal: small correction — I'm ines (legal). We can't accept any partner-supplied PII into a public demo bundle. Options: (A) fully synthetic dataset (recommended), (B) partner-provided redacted subset with a DPA + signed AUP. Also need to include the data processing clause in the marketplace listing. I'll attach the checklist.

kai-eng: Technical notes from runtime side: Snowflake marketplace prefers staged reproducible assets (CSV or Snowflake share). Databricks prefers Delta table with partitioning. For vector DB bundles (Qdrant/Weaviate) we should include precomputed embeddings (float32) + schema.json mapping column -> vector field. Also include an "embedding-config.json" with model name + dimension + tokenizer. Without that customers hit friction.

jenna-docs: Docs ask: short README, 1-2 notebooks (Snowflake SQL import & Databricks delta read), and a notebook showing how to load to a vector DB and run similarity search. Also need a one-paragraph privacy blurb for the marketplace tile.

olivia-partners: @ines-legal @kai-eng thanks — Devin can we switch the synthetic generator to output both CSV + Delta export? Keeps things consistent. Also please add a small sample of 200 rows flagged as "mini" for quick demos.

devin-ps: Yep — will output: 
```
s3://redwood-demos/partner-sandbox/2367899999/
  - full_synthetic_10k.csv
  - mini_sample_200.csv
  - embeddings_10k.npy
  - embedding-config.json
  - databricks_delta_export/  (delta files)
  - readme.md
```
I'll ensure the embeddings use our v1-embedding-1024 model and include the tokenizer hash.

ines-legal: For the licensing line: propose we ship synthetic under "Redwood Demo License v1 (non-commercial demo)" and partner-provided pieces (if any) require partner signoff + restricted listing. I'll DM legal template. Also log retention: we must not expose request logs in the demo.

kai-eng: Implementation checklist for each target:
- Snowflake: provide share or CSV + CREATE TABLE stmt + sample COPY statement.
- Databricks: Delta with partitioning + manifest + notebook to mount.
- Vector DBs: precomputed embeddings + schema.json + example vector insert script.
Can someone own the Snowflake SQL snippet?

jenna-docs: I'll draft the README + two notebooks. Need the COPY statement and the Delta export path.

olivia-partners: Action items then: 
- @devin-ps produce CSV, Delta, embeddings + embedding-config (due EOD +2 days)
- @kai-eng produce Snowflake COPY + vector insert script + small validation harness (due +3 days)
- @ines-legal provide license blurb + DPA guidance (due +3 days)
- @jenna-docs write README + notebooks (draft +4 days)
I'll schedule a 30m check-in in 5 days to finalize package.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Marketplace draft submission window opens in 7 business days. See https://marketplace.redwood.internal/submissions.

sam-marketing: Also flagging marketing: ask for a 30s demo video recorded from the mini sample and a 1-pager with bulletable value props for Snowflake/Databricks buyers. Jenna — can you own the 1-pager?

jenna-docs: I can do the 1-pager. Will need the mini sample link and a short script.

devin-ps: Uploaded preliminary artifacts to the staging bucket: s3://redwood-demos/staging/2367899999/mini_sample_200.csv (private link shared via DM). Note: embeddings file will be uploaded after dimension verification.

ines-legal: Quick legal note — add a single sentence to the README: "This demo package contains synthetic data generated by Redwood; it does not contain personal data and is intended for evaluation only." That should clear most marketplace reviewers.

kai-eng: For QA: I'll run the sample through our ingest pipeline and confirm we can replicate the same latency/embedding quality in the partner environment. If any incompatibility, I'll post a short log snippet here.

olivia-partners: Excellent. We'll treat partner-facing bundles as "private preview" until legal signs off. If anyone hits blockers ping me. Meeting invite for check-in sent. :calendar:
